title: Notarization for MacOS export under Windows in Godot 4.2. Failed with "invalid number at line 1 column 2"
key_points: The user is attempting to export a project for macOS using Godot 4.2 stable on Windows.
The notarization fails with the message 'invalid number at line 1 column 2'.
The user could not find more logs about the error and the godot.log was not updated with new information related to exporting attempts.
The rcodesign tool's notary-log command returned an error as the SUBMISSION_ID is unknown since Godot handles notarization internally.
limitations: Limited logging in Godot which makes it hard to diagnose errors during export
Notarization process handled internally by Godot, making it difficult for users to manually track or troubleshoot
asserts: The current Godot 4.2 stable release on Windows does not successfully perform macOS notarization when exporting projects.
scope: Exporting a project for macOS using Godot 4.2 stable on a Windows operating system
